paperTitle: MolmoAct2: Action Reasoning Models for Real-world Deployment
organization: Allen Institute for AI / University of Washington

benchmarks.label: LIBERO
benchmarks.detail: Suites: libero spatial 97.8 · libero object 100.0 · libero goal 97.8 · libero long 93.2 | Table 8 | Notes: MolmoAct2-LIBERO checkpoint fine-tuned on the full LIBERO training mixture; four standard LIBERO suites.

benchmarks.label: RoboEval
benchmarks.detail: Tasks: reported average over 8 RoboEval manipulation tasks | Figure 6 and Section 6.3 | Notes: Paper reports MolmoAct2 attains 44.3% success rate on RoboEval after fine-tuning the MolmoAct2-Post checkpoint on the RoboEval dataset. Figure 6 shows task-wise bars for Cube Handover, Lift Pot, Lift Tray, Pack Box, Pick Book, Rotate Valve, Stack Book Shelf, and Stack Two Blocks, but the paper text provides only the aggregate numeric score.
